manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Drafts a Monday-morning weekly status email for your team, combining your top-of-mind priorities, key executive meetings for the week, and progress metrics pulled from Fabric, held for your review before sending.
manifest.display_name: Generate and send your weekly status automatically
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/generate_and_send_your_weekly_status

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

fabric_metrics.description: Which Fabric metrics tied to your priorities to include, with progress since last week.

key_meetings.description: The week's meetings to feature, typically executive ones, from your calendar.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

schedule.description: When it should run recurring, e.g. every Monday morning.

team_recipients.description: The team distribution list or people the weekly email goes to.

top_of_mind.description: Your key priorities and projects for the week to highlight in the update.
